name: Kavren
coords: x east, y up, z south (north is -z), meters, map centered at the origin. rotY: three.js yaw, rotY 0 means the prop front (+Z in its GLB) faces +z (south). y is the prop origin height, already on the terrain.
propsSource: apps/client/public/models/props/<prop>.glb (LOD0..LOD2 child nodes), colliders in colliders.json, LOD distances in manifest.json

terrain.heightsEncoding: 16-byte header <4sHHhhHH: 'QWHF', version 1, samples per side 73, origin x -144, origin z -144, cell size 400 cm, 100 units per meter; then 73 x 73 int16 little endian centimeters, row-major, row along z (north to south), col along x (west to east)
terrain.groundEncoding: 16-byte header <4sHHhhHH: 'QWGP', version 1, samples per side 73, origin x, origin z, cell size cm, legend length; then 73 x 73 uint8, same order as the heights

chunks.id: one chunk (the map is small): chunk = 0

water.note: no water: the terrain stays above 4 m everywhere

zonesNote: callout areas for the HUD and the kill feed; the deathmatch has no loot tiers

playArea.note: center line of the outer hedgerow ring (closed polygon). The hedges (8 m pieces 7 m apart, a berm to 0.85 m under a 2.9 m hedge) cannot be crossed; the play area is the polygon shrunk by `inset` m. Everything outside is scenery. The loader's invisible walls (size / 2 - 6) stay as a backstop.

dmSpawnsNote: [x, y, z, yaw]: feet position on open ground (terrain + 0.1 m), at least 15 m apart, clear of every prop. yaw is the player yaw (input yaw): 0 looks north (-z), the duck looks along (-sin yaw, -cos yaw); each spawn looks down its longest open line, leaning toward the middle of the map
